name: Sage
shortDescription: Velvety grey-green leaves with a savoury aroma.
description: Sage is a hardy, woody herb known for its soft, textured leaves and strong earthy fragrance.
use: Butter sauces, stuffing, roasted vegetables and tea.
growingTips: Give sage full sun and well-drained soil. Harvest a few leaves at a time and avoid keeping the roots soggy.
